paragraphs: Rav Menashya of Dovil, in Shemuel's time. The people of Bashkar sent to Levi, 'What about a canopy?'. Before he went, Levi died. Shemuel told Rav Menashya, 'If you are wise, send them,' chapter Tolin 139a. Rav Menashya said: Shemuel said, Menaḥot 35b. I did not find the word Dovil. We find only Rav Yosef son of Rav Menashya of Dovil sending to Shemuel, Gittin 81a, and several places have Rav Yosef bar Rav Menashya of Dovil (see his entry). Perhaps Tolin and Menaḥot above lack the word Dovil, or it is someone else.
